aboutMe.description: Hi, I'm Simone! I'm a freelance software developer and photographer, with a Master's degree in Computer Science from the University of Parma. about.bio1: Hi, I'm Simone! I'm a freelance software developer and photographer, with a Master's degree in Computer Science from the University of Parma. My journey, both personal and academic, began as a child with artistic roller skating-a sport that taught me the values of resilience, discipline, and patience. Over the years, I learned the organizational skills needed to balance life as a competitive athlete and a student. Today, those lessons let me handle the rigor of technical work and the attention to detail I apply to my projects.
about.bio2: Throughout my academic and professional career, I have explored complex and diverse fields: from bioinformatics and parallel computing to artificial intelligence and cybersecurity. My experience spans from web development to operating system management and server environment configuration-areas that have given me a broad understanding of software infrastructure. I believe in the value of technical knowledge sharing, which is why I actively participate in open-source projects and community collaborations. My work today centers on LLM- and RAG-based systems and on-premise deployment.
about.bio3: The passion I dedicated to sport for many years led me back to where I grew up, but with a new perspective. My goal today is to immortalize athletic gestures and the emotion of competition through sports photography. Along the way, I also love capturing the most significant moments in people's lives, such as graduations and events, as well as the small details of nature.

freelanceHub.title: Freelance hub
freelanceHub.description: I was handling clients and projects across Obsidian folders, forms, email and WhatsApp: the information existed, but it had to be reconstructed by hand every time. Freelance Hub keeps it in one place, from the first lead to the payment, and derives revenue forecasts and time planning proposals from it. Built in TDD: 843 tests with a 100% coverage threshold enforced by the pipeline, mypy --strict type checking and a full DevSecOps chain. The assistant runs on language models executed locally, through Ollama or LM Studio, so client data never leaves the machine.
freelanceHub.shortDescription: From first lead to payment in one place, with revenue forecasts and time planning. Built in TDD: 843 tests, 100% coverage enforced by the pipeline.

mgp.title: MGP - Production management
mgp.description: A manufacturing company prepared every work order through an Excel file, seven or eight sheets laid out by hand and a chain of scripts, with a hard limit of 21 product rows. MGP is the platform that took that process over: the operator fills in the work order, the system runs the calculations, generates the documents and production files, and returns an archive already organised. The company configures its own product types, from the fields to the formulas to the files produced, without touching the code. Later extended to truck load planning for production and quotations, a link to the machines over OPC UA, and a built-in support module.
mgp.shortDescription: From a process spread across Excel, macros and scripts to a platform that generates production files and plans truck loads, configurable without code.
mgp.keywords: production management software, work order management, manufacturing process automation, product configurator, DXF generation, truck load planning, nesting, load optimisation, OPC UA, machine integration, custom manufacturing software

photographyDelivery.title: Photo Delivery
photographyDelivery.description: Prototype of a self-hosted photo delivery platform engineered around a strict threat model - access-coded galleries, encrypted orders, full-res email delivery. Customer billing sealed with AES-256-GCM, secrets hashed with Argon2id, email lookups indirected through HMAC-SHA256 with a dedicated pepper, append-only audit logs across every flow, sliding-window rate limits in Redis. FastAPI + async SQLAlchemy on PostgreSQL 16, Nuxt 3 in strict mode, exposed only through Cloudflare Tunnel - the backend never reaches the public internet. Every commit walks a mandatory pre-commit gate - gitleaks, ruff, pytest, typecheck - before it lands on the branch.
photographyDelivery.shortDescription: Self-hosted photo delivery service: galleries behind an access code, encrypted orders, email delivery after payment and a backend never exposed to the internet.

privacy.dataBody: The site stores technical preferences for language, theme and cookie choices. With your consent it uses Google Analytics 4 for statistics about page visits and contact clicks, for both software development and photography. There are no contact forms: email buttons open your mail application.
privacy.hostingBody: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). The provider automatically records technical logs, which may include the IP address, to keep the service running and secure.
privacy.fontsBody: Fonts are hosted on this website. Google Analytics is loaded from Google only after consent to statistics. External links open services covered by their respective privacy notices.
privacy.emailBody: If you write to me, I will process your address and the content of your message in order to reply and to manage any resulting professional relationship. The legal basis is the performance of pre-contractual measures and the legitimate interest in replying.
privacy.rightsBody: You can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and object to the processing of your data by writing to the address above. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority. You can also withdraw consent and request data portability where applicable.
privacy.analyticsBody: The purpose is to understand which content and services interest visitors and improve the website. The legal basis is your optional, revocable consent (GDPR Article 6(1)(a)). Google receives pseudonymous cookie identifiers, device and browser information, visited pages, referral information and interactions. Contact clicks are grouped by area and service: we do not send email contents. A click does not prove an enquiry was sent. The site does not request advertising features or ad personalisation. Without consent the Analytics tag is not loaded.
privacy.storageBody: Your statistics choice is stored in your browser for six calendar months, with its date, expiry and notice version. Browsing alone does not renew it. The theme and i18nextLng preferences retain your theme and language until you delete them. After consent, _ga and _ga_* cookies distinguish browsers and sessions; the site sets a 180-day lifetime without automatic renewal. User and event data in Google Analytics are retained for 2 months, without resetting retention on new activity. Deletion follows Google’s monthly processing cycle. This limit does not apply to aggregated statistical reports, which remain available in the Analytics property while the controller maintains it.
privacy.recipientsBody: The controller accesses the statistics. The contractual provider of the standard service for Italy is Google Ireland Limited, processing data on the controller’s behalf under the linked data processing terms. Google LLC and other subprocessors listed by Google may be involved. The service may involve transfers outside the European Economic Area: covered transfers to certified US recipients rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework adequacy decision; other transfers rely on the safeguards in Google’s terms, including standard contractual clauses where applicable. You can consult the safeguards below or ask the controller for information.
privacy.choicesBody: You can refuse statistics without losing access to content. Cookie preferences in the footer and on this page let you change your choice at any time. Rejecting after acceptance blocks new measurements, removes accessible Analytics cookies and reloads the page to deactivate code already loaded. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of earlier processing or automatically delete previously transmitted data. Your choice is shared only between tabs of the same browser and origin.

development.intro: Web applications, automation and integration between systems, tailored to small and medium-sized businesses. Built around the way you work, to improve it.
development.service1Body: Applications to govern processes that today live in spreadsheets and email threads: configurators, automatic document generation, integration between systems that do not talk to each other. From requirements analysis to deployment.
development.service2Body: Planning problems with too many variables to solve by hand: load plans, assignments, allocations. I have worked on them in industrial production, in university administration and in finance, with MiniZinc, OR-Tools and Answer Set Programming.
development.service3Body: When the problem does not fit a simple loop: parallelisation, purpose-built algorithms, C++ where performance matters.
development.service4Body: Containerised releases, reproducible environments, observability and maintenance after release. The project does not end at delivery.
development.service5Body: Presentation sites for professionals and small businesses: a few pages, considered content, quick to load and easy to find. This site is one of them.
development.service6Body: The same data typed in three times, documents redone by hand at every stage, spreadsheets nobody is sure who updates any more. I bring the stages together into one system, where each hands the next what it has already worked out.
development.howBody: We start from a requirements analysis done together, with goals and constraints written down. From there we agree on a scope and an estimate. I develop in verifiable increments, with automated tests and documented architectural decisions, so that by the end the code stays readable to someone who did not write it.
development.contactBody: Tell me what problem you need to solve, under what constraints and by when. I reply with a written proposal and an estimate, with no obligation.
development.areaTitle: Where I work and which sectors
development.areaBody: I work from Salsomaggiore Terme with small and medium-sized businesses in Parma, Fidenza, Piacenza and Reggio Emilia. My focus is manufacturing, window and door makers and logistics, where the same figures move from one Excel sheet to the next before they reach production.
development.sectorManufacturingBody: From the order to the production files: calculations, bills of materials and documents generated by the system instead of being filled in again by hand, with the link to the machines.
development.sectorWindowsBody: Product configurators that turn the measurements and chosen options into a quote, a bill of materials and production documents, without copying data from one file to another.
development.sectorLogisticsBody: Load plans and shipment planning calculated by the software from the order data, instead of being drawn by hand.

cookies.title: Website statistics, only if you agree
cookies.body: I use Google Analytics to understand visits to my software and photography services and contact button clicks. Google Analytics and statistical cookies load only if you accept. Rejecting or closing with X lets you continue without statistics. You can change your choice using cookie preferences in the footer.
cookies.statusAccepted: Current choice: statistics allowed. Closing with X withdraws consent.
cookies.inactive: Statistics are currently disabled. Google Analytics is not loaded and no new statistical cookies are set. Only preferences needed for the website to function remain active.
cookies.storageError: Your browser could not save this choice. Statistics remain disabled on this page. You may be asked again; if you previously accepted, clear this website’s browser data to remove the old saved choice too.
